body:
## Summary
- Keeps the paginated REST pull-files endpoint as the canonical changed-file source.
- Uses GraphQL only as an independent completeness and exact path-set reconciliation check.
- Removes the arbitrary 200-page / 20,000-file ceiling that rejected a valid page 201.

## Fix
- Adds GraphQL `totalCount`, requires a non-negative integer, and pins it across every page.
- Continues pagination until a validated terminal page without a fixed size cap.
- Fails closed on GraphQL errors; malformed repository, pull request, files, pageInfo, or nodes shapes; malformed or duplicate paths; count overflow; final count mismatch; and changing totalCount.
- Requires every nonterminal page to add paths and provide a non-empty, advancing, never-repeated cursor.
- Reconciles exact REST and GraphQL path sets only after GraphQL harvest is structurally and count-complete.

## Tests
- Focused boundaries: 0, 99, 100, 101, 20,000, and 20,001 files, including valid page 201.
- Failure cases: missing/empty/repeated cursor, empty progress page, changing or malformed totalCount, duplicate path, GraphQL errors, malformed nested shapes and nodes, second-page API failure, count overflow, exact final-count mismatch, and REST/GraphQL mismatch.
- Local validation on head `c59fec307e5340cd50acedf73d1d080d4654331d`:
  - `uv run --frozen --extra test pytest -q tests/pr_steward/`
  - `python -m compileall -q tools/pr_steward tests/pr_steward`
  - `git diff --check`
  - scoped Ruff and pre-commit checks

## Scope
Only `tools/pr_steward/collector.py` and focused PR Steward pagination/security-release tests changed. Review thread remains unresolved until exact-head CI and independent audit pass.

commits.messageBody:
…past 100 files

tools/pr_steward/collector.py's _fetch_changed_files_with_pagination_check
independently verifies the REST-paginated changed-files list (already
correctly paginated via `gh api --paginate`) against a second, GraphQL-based
source, as a defense against `gh pr view --json files` silently truncating
large file lists. That GraphQL query only ever fetched a single 100-item
page and reported "changedFiles harvest exceeded first 100 files" -- a hard,
permanent HARVEST_INCOMPLETE blocker -- for any PR with more than 100
changed files, rather than genuinely completing the check.

Encountered this directly: PR #1152 (the FDOS-004 ChatGPT Project source
refresh) grew past 100 changed files across its own repair commits, and
PR Steward's real CI run blocked on exactly this, unrelated to anything in
the PR's own content.

Fix: the query now paginates via `after: $cursor` until GraphQL's own
`hasNextPage` resolves to false, bounded by a generous 200-page (20,000
file) safety backstop -- comfortably above the largest PR this repo has
seen (#1123, 16,206 files) -- so a truncation error now only fires for a
genuine anomaly, not routine large-PR pagination. Also hardened: a response
claiming hasNextPage=true but supplying no endCursor is now treated as
incomplete rather than silently accepted as done.

Added tests/pr_steward/test_collector_changed_files_pagination_check.py
covering single-page, multi-page (paginating past the first 100),
never-terminating, missing-cursor, and reconciliation-mismatch cases.
Updated two existing tests in test_collector_security_release_approval.py
whose fixtures mock a single non-paginating response and hardcoded the old
one-page error string; their assertions now match the new pagination
behavior and error wording. Full tests/pr_steward/ suite passes (91 tests).

Verified live against PR #1152: before this fix, harvest_errors included
"changedFiles harvest exceeded first 100 files"; after, that error is gone
(confirmed via a direct `python -m tools.pr_steward.intake` run against the
live PR).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
